question: Three directed elements in a mathematical model are represented by $\vec{p}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+\hat{k}$, $\vec{q}=4\hat{i}+4\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ and $\vec{r}=-6\hat{i}-6\hat{j}-3\hat{k}$. The students must compare the lengths and orientations of these elements. They know that vectors proportional to the same nonzero vector are collinear and that the sign of the proportionality constant determines whether their directions are the same or opposite.(a) Calculate the magnitudes of $\vec{p}$, $\vec{q}$ and $\vec{r}$.(b) Express $\vec{q}$ and $\vec{r}$ as scalar multiples of $\vec{p}$.(c) Establish that the three vectors are collinear and compare their directions.(d) Obtain unit vectors in the directions of $\vec{p}$ and $\vec{r}$ and compare them.
explanation: (a)`|\vec{p}|=\sqrt{2^2+2^2+1^2}=3|\vec{q}|=\sqrt{4^2+4^2+2^2}=6|\vec{r}|=\sqrt{(-6)^2+(-6)^2+(-3)^2}=9`(b)Comparing corresponding components gives`\vec{q}=2\vec{p}`and`\vec{r}=-3\vec{p}`(c)Both $\vec{q}$ and $\vec{r}$ are scalar multiples of $\vec{p}$. Therefore, all three vectors are parallel to the same line and are collinear. Since the multiplier in $\vec{q}=2\vec{p}$ is positive, $\vec{q}$ and $\vec{p}$ have the same direction. Since the multiplier in $\vec{r}=-3\vec{p}$ is negative, $\vec{r}$ has the direction opposite to $\vec{p}$ and $\vec{q}$.(d)The unit vector in the direction of $\vec{p}$ is`\hat{p}=\frac{\vec{p}}{|\vec{p}|}=\frac{1}{3}(2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+\hat{k})`The unit vector in the direction of $\vec{r}$ is`\hat{r}=\frac{\vec{r}}{|\vec{r}|}=\frac{1}{9}(-6\hat{i}-6\hat{j}-3\hat{k})\hat{r}=-\frac{1}{3}(2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+\hat{k})=-\hat{p}`Thus, the two unit vectors have equal magnitudes and opposite directions.

options.A:
(a) $|\vec{p}|=3$, $|\vec{q}|=6$, $|\vec{r}|=9$
(b) $\vec{q}=2\vec{p}$, $\vec{r}=3\vec{p}$
(c) All are collinear and have the same direction
(d) $\hat{r}=\hat{p}=\frac{1}{3}(2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+\hat{k})$
options.B:
(a) $|\vec{p}|=3$, $|\vec{q}|=6$, $|\vec{r}|=9$
(b) $\vec{q}=2\vec{p}$, $\vec{r}=-3\vec{p}$
(c) They are collinear; $\vec{q}$ has the same direction as $\vec{p}$ and $\vec{r}$ the opposite direction
(d) $\hat{p}=\frac{1}{3}(2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+\hat{k})$, $\hat{r}=-\hat{p}$
options.D:
(a) $|\vec{p}|=\sqrt{7}$, $|\vec{q}|=2\sqrt{7}$, $|\vec{r}|=3\sqrt{7}$
(b) $\vec{q}=2\vec{p}$, $\vec{r}=-3\vec{p}$
(c) The vectors are perpendicular in pairs
(d) $\hat{r}=-\hat{p}$
